title: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN URBAN
IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of
1958)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th March, 2001]
No. Legis: 1-32/Law/75, dated
17-3-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
10th March, 2001 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Urban
Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Act V of 1958

ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN URBAN
IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of
1958)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th March, 2001]
No. Legis: 1-32/Law/75, dated
17-3-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
10th March, 2001 is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Act V of 1958.--In the Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958,
for clause (h) of section 4, the following shall be substituted:-
"(h) One
residential house owned and self-occupied for his residential purpose by every
citizen".
